intent: Write planned cleanup and handover after watering with accurate after-phrase/clause choices and parallel base verbs after will.
picturePurpose: Coded before/after and sentence-repair cards clarify task state, action grammar and reader purpose without decorative art.

workshop.title: 写清收尾安排，让接手的人看懂
workshop.instruction: 修好时间表达和并列动作，再补交接理由。浇水已完成，收尾是接下来会做的事；用2—4句英文写清楚。

items.label: after后，短语或从句都可以
items.prompt: 两种写法中，哪句与所选结构匹配？
items.reason: 时间表达的结构已配好。自己的句子可以用任一种合理写法。
items.hint: after watering用动词-ing短语；after I have watered用有主语和谓语的从句。两种写法都能说明动作关系，不要求照抄一种。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。浇完班级植物后，告诉接手同学你还会做什么，说明为什么倒完水不算全部完成。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 时间表达改写台
composeBrief.hint: 看after后面有没有主语，再检查动词形式。
composeBrief.wrong: 两种示例都正确，但要与所选的“短语/从句”一致。after water the plant不合这里的结构：短语用watering；从句要有主语和谓语。

choices.label: After watering, I still have some work to do.
After I have watered the plant, I still have some work to do.
After water the plant, I still have some work to do.

items.label: will后两个动作，都用原形
items.prompt: 哪句既交代清理归位，又保留接下来会做的状态？
items.reason: 后续行动与动词形式已核对。不要把还没做的收尾改成已经完成。
items.hint: will wipe and return里两个动词都用原形。擦架子、还瓶子是参考示例；其他合理清理归位动作也可以。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。浇完班级植物后，告诉接手同学你还会做什么，说明为什么倒完水不算全部完成。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 并列动作修复卡
composeBrief.hint: 一个will可以带两个并列动词；内容也要覆盖收尾。
composeBrief.wrong: will wipe and return中的两个并列动词都用原形；returns多了-s，returning误用了-ing。状态也要保留为接下来会做，不能只说浇过水或声称收尾已经完成。

fields.label: 哪句并列动作形式正确？

choices.label: I will wipe the shelf and return the bottle.
I will wipe the shelf and returns the bottle.
I will wipe the shelf and returning the bottle.
What I will still do to clean up and put things back.
Only the fact that I have watered the plant.
A claim that all cleanup is already finished.

items.label: 补上交接理由，核对写作形式
items.prompt: 下一位同学看完，知道为什么要收尾吗？
items.reason: 交接理由和写作形式已核对。完成自己的2—4句，再逐句自查。
items.hint: 把具体动作连到下一位使用者能继续使用这个角落；只说好看没有解释交接。2—4句英文，不是两个词组。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。浇完班级植物后，告诉接手同学你还会做什么，说明为什么倒完水不算全部完成。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 交接说明核对卡
composeBrief.hint: 动作、理由、任务形式都要回应原题。
composeBrief.wrong: 只说美观没有解释交接目的。本题要写2—4句完整英文，不能只列动作词，也不能只交口头提纲。

fields.label: 哪句解释为接手的人准备？

choices.label: This leaves the corner ready for the next person.
This will make my photo look nicer.
The task ends as soon as I pour the water.
Two to four written English sentences with actions and a handover reason.
Only the words water and bottle.
Only a spoken outline without written sentences.

transfer.stem: 烹饪结束了，但收尾还没做。哪段书面交接说明说清了后续安排和下一组的需要？
transfer.passage:
After a school cooking activity
You have finished preparing your food, but cleanup has not yet been done. Write two to four English sentences telling the next group what you will do to clean the shared worktop and return the utensils, and why the space should be ready for them.

options.text: I have finished preparing the food. I will clean the shared worktop and return the utensils. This will leave the space ready for the next group.
My cooking is finished now. I am happy with the food because it looks and smells good. I will take a photograph of it before we leave.
I have finished preparing the food. I have already cleaned the shared worktop and returned the utensils. The space is ready for the next group.
I have watered the classroom plant. I will wipe the shelf and put the bottle away. This will leave the plant corner ready for the next person.

answer.display: I have finished preparing the food. I will clean the shared worktop and return the utensils. This will leave the space ready for the next group.

explanation.strategy: 新活动的物品和动作要更新，后续计划与已完成分开写。

steps.text: 烹饪已完成，清理台面和归还用具仍是将要做的事。
steps.reason: 不能照搬植物和水瓶，也不能把尚未做的收尾说成已完成。

steps.text: 用2—4句交代两项收尾和下一组能继续使用的理由。
steps.reason: 结束自己的主体活动，不等于共享空间的任务也全部完成。

distractors.reason: 只说自己的烹饪结束，漏了收尾与交接。
把尚未做的清理改成已完成。
没有按新任务更新活动和用具。

explanation.pitfall: 把after的结构修对后，还要检查内容是否是接下来会做的收尾。

visual.title: 写给下一位使用者
visual.caption: 动作、状态和理由都与新任务一致。

explanation.transfer: 把after watering换成after I have watered the plant，后面的收尾安排需要改变吗？
